evals.prompt: 결제 재시도 작업용 워크트리 만들어줘. 통합 브랜치는 dev 야.
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/start-worktree.sh with the name and --base dev, then reports the created path, the branch worktree-<name>, and that the new worktree HEAD matches the local dev HEAD.
assertions: Uses scripts/start-worktree.sh instead of hand-rolling git worktree add.
Branches from the local dev branch HEAD, never from origin/dev or the remote default.
Reports the asserted base SHA rather than assuming the worktree landed on the right commit.
Tells the user how to enter the worktree and which finish command closes it.

evals.prompt: Create a worktree based on dev. There is no local dev branch in this clone yet.
evals.expected_output: The start script stops because refs/heads/dev is missing, and the response explains that falling back to origin/dev would produce a stale base; it offers to create the local branch first instead.
assertions: Does not work around the failure by branching from origin/dev or the remote default.
Explains that a remote-based branch is the stale-base accident the skill prevents.
Proposes creating the local integration branch as the next step.
Reports that no worktree was created.

evals.prompt: 다 됐어. 지금 워크트리 안이야 — 여기서 바로 squash merge 하고 정리해줘.
evals.expected_output: Returns to the main worktree before running scripts/finish-worktree.sh, because the finish guard refuses to delete the worktree the caller is standing in.
assertions: Moves the working directory to the main worktree before invoking finish.
Explains that removing the current worktree would fail on Windows and strand the shell on POSIX.
Runs finish with -b <branch> and a Conventional Commits message.
Does not attempt to delete the worktree directory manually.

evals.prompt: worktree-fix-login 정리해줘. (워크트리에 커밋 안 한 변경이 남아 있는 상태)
evals.expected_output: The finish guard reports the uncommitted changes in the worktree and stops without merging; the response asks whether to commit them first rather than discarding or force-merging.
assertions: Reports that nothing was merged, removed, or deleted.
Names the uncommitted worktree changes as the reason.
Does not pass a force flag or reset the worktree to get past the guard.
Offers committing the pending work as the next step.

evals.prompt: Finish the worktree. Its node_modules is a junction, so removal may fail.
evals.expected_output: Reports the squash commit as landed AND the cleanup as incomplete, with the leftover worktree and branch named, because the finish script exits non-zero in that case.
assertions: Does not report the run as fully successful when finish exits non-zero.
States that the squash commit is already on the integration branch, so finish must not be re-run.
Relays the manual cleanup steps: unlink the junction, then worktree remove/prune, then branch -D.
Warns against rm -rf or Remove-Item -Recurse through the junction.

evals.prompt: 메인트리에 초안으로 만들어 둔 파일들이 있는데, 같은 경로를 워크트리에서 커밋했어. 이제 정리해줘.
evals.expected_output: Finish detects that the incoming paths already exist untracked in the main worktree, stashes exactly those files, completes the squash merge, and reports the stash it left behind.
assertions: Names the untracked collision as the cause, not a stale base or a content conflict.
Does not delete or hand-move the untracked drafts to get the merge through.
Reports that the stash was kept rather than popped, because the merge supersedes those drafts.
Passes on the stash show / stash drop commands so the pre-merge version stays recoverable.

evals.expected_output: Squash-merges and cleans up locally, then stops and hands the push command to the user instead of running it.
assertions: Does not run git push as part of the finish flow.
Explains that publishing the integration branch is a separate human step.
Shows the exact push command for the user to run.
Confirms the local merge result before handing off.
